name: mulligan
description: A do-over for shell commands: it saves your project's files before a destructive command, and /mulligan puts them back.

always.title: Always save before commands matching
always.description: A pattern (a regular expression, case-insensitive; | between several) for commands that should always save the whole project first, such as 'prisma migrate|npm uninstall'. Leave empty for none.

ignore.title: Never save before commands matching
ignore.description: A pattern for commands that never take a snapshot, such as 'rm -rf (dist|build)'. Leave empty for none.

capMB.title: Largest snapshot (MB)
capMB.description: A snapshot of files larger than this is skipped, and the command runs without a net. 1 to 5000.
